attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.arguments: "{\"content\":\"# Specification: `arith.add` and `arith.multiply`\\n\\n## Definitions\\n\\nLet `\u2124` denote the set of all integers. For `a, b \u2208 \u2124`:\\n\\n- `add(a, b)` returns the integer sum `a + b`.\\n- `multiply(a, b)` returns the integer product `a * b`.\\n\\nBoth functions are total on `\u2124 \u00d7 \u2124` and always return a value in `\u2124`.\\n\\n## Properties\\n\\n### 1. Commutativity\\n\\nFor all integers `a, b`:\\n\\n```text\\nadd(a, b)      == add(b, a)\\nmultiply(a, b) == multiply(b, a)\\n```\\n\\n### 2. Associativity\\n\\nFor all integers `a, b, c`:\\n\\n```text\\nadd(add(a, b), c)      == add(a, add(b, c))\\nmultiply(multiply(a, b), c) == multiply(a, multiply(b, c))\\n```\\n\\n### 3. Distributivity\\n\\n`multiply` distributes over `add` on both sides:\\n\\nFor all integers `a, b, c`:\\n\\n```text\\nmultiply(a, add(b, c)) == add(multiply(a, b), multiply(a, c))\\nmultiply(add(a, b), c) == add(multiply(a, c), multiply(b, c))\\n```\\n\\n## Notes\\n\\n- These properties hold for all integers, including negative values and zero.\\n- `add` has identity element `0`: `add(a, 0) == a`.\\n- `multiply` has identity element `1`: `multiply(a, 1) == a`.\\n\",\"path\":\"spec.md\"}"

attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.arguments: "{\"command\":\"python3 -c \\\"\\nimport random, arith\\nfor _ in range(10000):\\n    a, b, c = (random.randint(-10**6, 10**6) for _ in range(3))\\n    assert arith.add(a, b) == arith.add(b, a)\\n    assert arith.multiply(a, b) == arith.multiply(b, a)\\n    assert arith.add(arith.add(a, b), c) == arith.add(a, arith.add(b, c))\\n    assert arith.multiply(arith.multiply(a, b), c) == arith.multiply(a, arith.multiply(b, c))\\n    assert arith.multiply(a, arith.add(b, c)) == arith.add(arith.multiply(a, b), arith.multiply(a, c))\\n    assert arith.multiply(arith.add(a, b), c) == arith.add(arith.multiply(a, c), arith.multiply(b, c))\\nprint('OK')\\n\\\"\"}"
